decisions.reason: Although its website prominence fell from a dedicated page to a mention, it is close to the core upholstery offer and prior launch investment makes management more likely to continue it than to admit a failed launch.

This fabric appears only as a website mention and so carries limited public commitment, but because it fits the established decorative range in a growing market the firm is still more likely to retain it for now.
A dedicated page in both years signals visible commitment, and its functional flame-retardant positioning fits the firm's contract-textile strengths, making withdrawal unlikely.

It builds on the existing collection and the wool-blend concept can be defended as consistent with the firm's design and material direction, so management is likely to continue it despite only modest public emphasis.
This product has only moderate visible commitment, but it extends the firm's established decorative textile capabilities and can still be justified as part of the broader collection strategy.
As the newest launch with its own page, it reflects fresh investment and clear public commitment, which under escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it on the market.
